summary: Attacked the retry path and the config loader before disposition existed.

findings.title: Hot loop on 429 without Retry-After
findings.scenario: Server returns 429 with no Retry-After -> delay stays 0 -> hot loop
findings.note: Added a floor delay and a regression test.

findings.title: Config loader silently ignores a malformed override
findings.scenario: Malformed override -> falls back to default -> no crash, no data loss
findings.note: Unreachable from any documented config path.
